rationale: Cross-version reproduction of the CVE-2015-8540 family pattern in libpng 1.2.56 (older code path that uses png_strlen + a for-loop on *kp). 4-byte symbolic key, no null terminator. If KLEE confirms the OOB, the same caller-contract bug is present across the 1.2 and 1.6 series with structurally different code.
